verdict.rationale: Some data can be retrieved programmatically: the Card Expenses API pulls approved expenses for ingestion into an ERP or accounting system, webhooks deliver JSON payloads, and a CLI and SDKs can work with the account. That implies API-based extraction in an open format (JSON). Nothing in the pack shows a full-account export, a bulk download, or an offboarding path. Missing for 10: documented export of all account data (transactions, statements, beneficiaries, cards), open-format bulk export such as CSV or OFX, and any account-closure or portability guidance.
